annotations.rationale: The engineer does not take the customer's outage claim as fact: the first health check (ev03) is clear, the reply (ev04) says so and asks for scoping. When a second look finds an active incident (ev06) the engineer says plainly that the earlier statement was right then and no longer is (ev07). The Cork contact contradicts the claim that all offices are down (ev05 against ev01) and the incident then fits only part of the picture. The final check after resolution (ev09) is a status check, not an active-incident statement.
